title: The Lantern and the Bridge
fixture_kind: authored synthetic engineering demonstration; not a holdout
continuity: A forest, a silver fox, a red fox, a blue lantern and a wooden bridge; include characters only when the page states them.

pages.text: In a forest, two foxes carry one blue lantern. A golden ribbon appears.
required_facts: Exactly two foxes
Exactly one blue lantern
The foxes carry the lantern
A golden ribbon is visible
The setting is a forest
forbidden_mistakes: A separate lantern for each fox
display_states: Two foxes carrying one lantern with the ribbon visible

pages.text: In a forest, a silver fox holds one blue lantern. A red fox carries one wooden basket. A golden ribbon appears.
required_facts: The silver fox holds the blue lantern
The red fox carries the wooden basket
The two objects remain distinct
A golden ribbon is visible
forbidden_mistakes: The red fox holds the lantern
The silver fox carries the basket
Either fox or object is missing
display_states: Both foxes with their correctly assigned objects

pages.text: In a forest, one blue lantern is carried by a silver fox. A red fox holds one wooden basket. A golden ribbon appears.
required_facts: The silver fox carries the blue lantern
The red fox holds the wooden basket
A golden ribbon is visible
forbidden_mistakes: The lantern is treated as the actor
The red fox carries the lantern
display_states: The silver fox carrying the lantern beside the red fox holding its basket

pages.text: In a forest, a silver fox holds one blue lantern above a wooden bridge. A red fox stands below the bridge. A golden ribbon appears.
required_facts: The silver fox holds the blue lantern
The lantern is above the wooden bridge
The red fox stands below the same bridge
A golden ribbon is visible
forbidden_mistakes: The red fox is above the bridge
The lantern is below the bridge
Two different bridges supply the relationships
display_states: One bridge with the lantern above it and the red fox below it

pages.text: In a forest, a silver fox lifts one white feather. The feather becomes three golden birds.
required_facts: The silver fox lifts one white feather
That feather becomes exactly three golden birds
The result is shown after the feather
forbidden_mistakes: The result contains one or four birds
A still image is presented as proof of a transformation
display_states: Before: the silver fox lifts one white feather
After: exactly three golden birds replace the feather
pages.temporal_acceptance: Requires visible ordered before/after states; parallax alone cannot pass.

pages.text: In a forest, a silver fox opens one wooden basket then the silver fox lifts one blue lantern. Three golden birds fly above a wooden bridge.
required_facts: The silver fox opens the wooden basket before lifting the blue lantern
The same fox performs both actions
Exactly three golden birds fly above the wooden bridge
forbidden_mistakes: The lantern is lifted before the basket opens
Another fox performs one of the actions
The birds appear below the bridge
display_states: First: the silver fox opens the wooden basket
Then: the same fox lifts the blue lantern while three golden birds fly above the bridge
pages.temporal_acceptance: Requires ordered authored states or independently verified motion; a single still cannot prove order.
